Package org.apache.rat.testhelpers.data

Class AbstractTestDataProvider

java.lang.Object
org.apache.rat.testhelpers.data.AbstractTestDataProvider
Direct Known Subclasses:
ReportTestDataProvider
public abstract class AbstractTestDataProvider extends Object
Generates a list of TestData to test an implementation. The tests work by creating a Path Consumer to construct a directory under the test base directory and creating files and/or directories within that directory. A test validator is created to validate the expected results of the operation and a TestData object is created for each test.
Each TestData represents a single test of a command line option or set of options.
Use of this class ensures consistent testing across all available UIs.
